decision.summary: The screened region (610–635) contains a coherent multi-axis offset in N/E/U beginning around index 615–618 and persisting through 634 without reversal. The onset is gradual (not a step), interior is sustained but not perfectly flat, and the return is unobserved within allowed context—hence status uncertain. No isolated spikes or one-point anomalies dominate; motion is smooth but displaced. A missing observation at index 626 does not break coherence. No confirmed temporary interval due to absence of opposing return.
